Rebecca: Heads-up team 024-12-0309:15PT 0min sync. We're rolling a small 'preview eligibility + risk' triage to speed onboarding and flag renewal risk early. Plan: 1) nudge eligible signups with a 3-question form, 2) auto-score urgency + security needs, 3) route top signals to 1:1 slots, others to office hours. Form draft: https://redwood.ai/forms/preview-eligibility-v2

Mike: Nice. Keep the form tiny. Suggested fields: "primary use case", "production timeline (weeks)", "security needs: none/KMS/HSM/other". Add a checkbox for contractual compliance > legal touch.

Noor: I'll add a "renewal-risk" flag inferred from contract length + expansion requests. Rule idea: short-term contract + high usage = high-risk if not onboarded quickly. We can tag CS contacts as "high-touch".

Hank_sre: If they check KMS/HSM, we should surface required network notes to eng-oncall. Also watch for large batch ingestion patterns that could push our capacity. Quick log sample to look for: `SELECT acct, sum(tokens) FROM events WHERE ts > now()-interval '14 days' GROUP BY acct ORDER BY sum DESC LIMIT 50;`

Mike: Scoring prototype: `score = min(12, floor(log10(weekly_calls+1))) + (security != 'none')*4 + (contract_months<12)*2 + (prod_timeline_weeks<8)*3`. Anything >10 gets a priority 1:1.

Rebecca: Good. I'll coordinate calendar slots. We have 8 30-min priority slots/week free. For overflow we'll run a 30-min cohort drop-in Monday 11am PT. Can someone draft a short invite template?

Noor: Drafting invite + short enablement checklist. Will include playbook link and minimal checklist: API key, example prompt, expected QPS.

surveybot: form "preview-eligibility-v2" published by rebecca_cs at 2024-12-03T16:20:00Z -> https://redwood.ai/forms/preview-eligibility-v2

Hank_sre: Also suggest adding a tiny telemetry hook: when form submitted, emit event `preview.signup` with `security_req` so ops can prewire infra.

Rebecca: Action list: @mike_se finalize scoring and add to Coda; @noor_prod publish invite + one-pager by EOD; @hank_sre add telemetry hook and note for eng-oncall; I'll start nudges tomorrow morning targeting score>10.

Mike: On it. Will run initial scoring batch and share top 40 CSV in #cs-ops.

Noor: Posted invite + one-pager here: https://coda.io/d/preview-eligibility#Invite. Template includes 3 call options and a link to office hours.

Rebecca: Perfect. We'll reconvene Thu for status and to export feedback trends for product. Thanks :pray:
